title: OpenAI Codex and Figma launch seamless code-to-design experience
author: OpenAI / Modelverse Editorial
excerpt: OpenAI and Figma launch a new Codex integration that connects code and design, enabling teams to move between implementation and the Figma canvas to iterate and ship faster....
body:
